Who We Are

A Ministry
Rooted in the Word

Sword of the Spirit Ministries has its headquarters in Lansdowne, Pennsylvania, USA. After years of faithful evangelical work in Kenya, the ministry has grown to establish a strong presence across the country.

We currently have five active churches — four in Kisii and one in Murang'a — with three more upcoming congregations in the pipeline. Each church is a living community committed to the Gospel and the transformation of lives.

Our mission is simple: to preach the Word of God without compromise, to nurture believers into maturity, and to extend the Kingdom of God across Kenya and beyond.

Our Doctrine

What We Believe

We hold firmly to the historic Christian faith. These eleven articles form the foundation of our doctrine, worship, and community life.

01

We believe the Holy Bible as the inspired, inerrant Word of God — the all-sufficient authority in matters of faith, doctrine, and Christian living.

02

We believe in the Godhead — the Trinity — existing as the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

03

We believe in the Virgin Birth of Jesus Christ, His death on the cross for our sins, His bodily resurrection, His ascension, and His present ministry as our Great High Priest.

04

We believe man was created in God's image but fell into sin. Only through regeneration by the Holy Spirit can salvation and spiritual life be obtained.

05

We believe salvation is the free gift of God, entirely apart from man's works, received by faith in and through the atoning work of the Lord Jesus Christ.

06

We believe in a regenerated church membership — those who repent of their sins by free will, are justified by Calvary, and are filled with the Holy Spirit.

07

We believe water baptism is by full immersion and the Lord's Supper is a memorial to His suffering. These ordinances are observed but are not means of salvation.

08

We believe in the personal, bodily, imminent, and glorious return of the Lord Jesus Christ, inspiring believers to dynamic and zealous life in His service.

09

We believe in the bodily resurrection of the dead — everlasting blessedness for the saved and everlasting separation from God for the unsaved.

10

We believe in the autonomy of the local church. Each congregation manages its own affairs and is not subject to any external religious body or organization.

11

We believe in being filled with the Holy Spirit — as Romans 8:9 declares, "…Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of His."

Iron Sharpens Iron

ISI Organization

Iron Sharpens Iron (ISI) is a men's discipleship movement operating as part of what we do in Kenya. The organization spans four regions across the USA and Kenya.

Our Kenya Region Liaison coordinates local men with this global network of accountability, growth, and purpose.

"To raise a new generation of men — with Integrity, Humility, and Honor — who will live out their Identity in Christ, and will follow God no matter the cost, one man at a time."
Integrity
Wholeness between word and deed
Humility
Strength under submission
Honor
Esteeming God and others
Identity
Rooted in Christ alone
JM

Elder Jack Montgomery

President & Founder

A retired United States Air Force veteran, Elder Jack Montgomery founded ISI with a vision to build men of God who carry the Kingdom in their families, workplaces, and communities.
